sections.label: Counsel and clients
sections.title: In their <t>words.</t>
sections.lede: Letters published by Rodriguez & Associates, shown as the firm publishes them.

items.q: “In talking with jurors after trial, several commented that your testimony on the subject of commercial lending standards was particularly helpful to them in understanding the case. The case presented complex issues. Yet, according to several jurors, you presented the material in a way that made it easier for them to understand.”

“We retained Rick as an expert on construction financing in a significant arbitration in 2009. He delivered powerful and concise opinions. He also turned his cross-examination into points in our favor.”

“We have looked to Rick’s deep knowledge of commercial banking for more than a decade. Whether acting as an expert or consultant, he is responsive, practical and best of all, exercises excellent judgment.”

“Rick Rodriguez combines an impressive background in commercial banking with common sense and a wonderful communications style, making him highly effective in conveying his opinions as a testifying witness to jurors and judges.”

“Mr. Rodriguez is extremely knowledgeable, experienced and well-qualified to consult with and testify concerning banking policies and procedures. For anyone having need for a banking expert consultant or witness, I endorse Mr. Rodriguez without hesitation.”
“We also plainly owe a great measure of our success on the banks’ claims to your testimony in helping to educate the jury to the fundamental weaknesses of the bank’s position.”

groups.label: Security Pacific National Bank
names: Senior Vice President, Division Administrator, Real Estate Special Assets — 1990–1992. A classified loan portfolio of about $1.6 billion in commitments, across ten relationships
First Vice President, Regional Manager, Real Estate Industries Group — 1987–1990. A loan portfolio of $1 billion in outstanding commitments

First Vice President, Deputy Administrator and Credit Officer, Real Estate Industries Group — 1986–1987. Credit policy for a $6 billion real estate portfolio across California, with personal approval authority of $15 million
Vice President, Regional Manager, Real Estate Industries Group, Riverside — 1984–1986. Opened the regional office; a construction loan portfolio grown to $700 million
Vice President, World Corporate Group — 1983–1984. A corporate loan portfolio of $500 million in commitments
Vice President, Real Estate Special Assets — 1980–1983. Restructure and collection of $50 million in classified real estate loans
Assistant Vice President, Credit Review — 1980. Field audits of loan portfolios across the United States
Assistant Branch Manager — 1979–1980. Branch operations, deposit accounts and consumer loans

sections.sub: Rodriguez & Associates Advisory Group, downtown Los Angeles: workouts and restructuring, capital and real estate, and expert work for counsel.

items.t: In 1992, after thirteen years at Security Pacific, the last two as Senior Vice President over a classified real estate portfolio of about $1.6 billion.
items.d: The firm began where that work left off: resolving complex debtor-creditor transactions secured by real estate, stock and partnership interests.

items.t: Founder and Principal since 1992. The firm’s own pages credit its work to him by name.
items.d: Workout strategies for lenders, bid pricing for loan and REO pools, and capital raised through his contacts in the mortgage market.

items.t: Expert witness work and litigation support for counsel are engaged through Rodriguez & Associates.
items.d: With Emily Rodriguez, Partner, on discovery analysis, research, trial exhibits, expert reports and declarations.
